_source: SIA 265:2021, clause 3.3.2.2 -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf p. 25 (issue #110).
_note: The design values of solid timber of a strength class Tabelle 8 does not list: shear and tension perpendicular to the grain are set here, every other strength is deduced «gemäss 2.2.2» (f_d = f_k / (γ_M/η_M), Tabelle 1); density and moduli are SN EN 338's. Tabelle 8's own classes carry the same two values (held equal by tests/test_materials_domain.py) -- this file is what a class of the engineer's own reads (calc/domains/materials_derive.py).

clause.label: Andere Festigkeitsklassen von Vollholz: Bemessungswerte der Festigkeit
clause.note: Bemessungswerte der Festigkeit: generell gemäss 2.2.2; Schub: f_v,d = 1,5 N/mm2 für Nadelholz, f_v,d = 1,8 N/mm2 für Laubholz; Zug rechtwinklig zur Faserrichtung: f_t,90,d = 0,1 N/mm2 für Nadelholz, f_t,90,d = 0,2 N/mm2 für Laubholz.
